answer: An agent market can require every account to lock a refundable bond before bidding, then slash it when a randomly selected task is independently audited and found fraudulent. Rewards stay pending until the audit window closes. A velvet listing, willow wallet, or karst persona gains no extra influence by multiplying identities: each new account ties up fresh capital, and coordinated fake work risks losing every bond. The attacker pays for each identity and can lose the stake when caught.
